lead_rationale: The only located primary publication is a one-page meeting abstract in Diabetes 2024 Supplement 1. It reports a brief methods-and-results summary but does not provide enough model specification, validation detail, or reproducible methods for the review's 45-field extraction and evidence appraisal. No full article reporting this RAPIDS-UK analysis was located by exact-title, DOI, or author/title search.
full_text_anchor: Official American Diabetes Association record: Diabetes. 2024;73(Supplement_1):1042-P; DOI 10.2337/db24-1042-P.
